name: JWT Token Verification & Expiry
description: Implement HMAC-SHA256 JWT encoding and decoding in `app.py`. The `create_token(payload, secret, expires_in_sec)` function must generate a standard JWT (`header.payload.signature` encoded in URL-safe base64 without padding). The `decode_token(token, secret)` function must verify the cryptographic signature and ensure the token has not expired (`exp` claim). If expired, tampered, or invalid, raise `ValueError`.
visible_hint: A freshly created token should decode cleanly and return the original payload claims.
